```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(DT)
library(shiny)
library(dplyr)
devtools::load_all()

syntaxDir <- usethis::proj_get()
#source(system.file("tests", "dashboard.R", package = "deinPackage"))

# 👉 Objekt aus Parameter holen
hts_object <- params$hts_object
hts_name <- params$hts_name

# Basis-Check
if (is.null(hts_object)) {
  stop("hts_object wurde nicht übergeben!")
}

# qr_table <- data.frame(
#   series = names(hts_object),
#   quality = runif(length(hts_object))
# )

# Aggregate + Komponenten
components <- hts_object$components

# series_names <- c("aggregate", names(components))
# 
# qr_table <- data.frame(
#   series = series_names,
#   quality = runif(length(series_names))
# )

# Aggregate + Komponenten
components <- hts_object$components

series_names <- c("aggregate", names(components))

# Diagnostics holen
diag <- hts_object$diagnosticsTable()

# suche die Spalte, die die Seriennamen enthält
name_col <- setdiff(names(diag), c("Q", "Q2", "TotalQ", "seasonality"))[1]

# Mapping
qr_table <- data.frame(
  series = series_names,
  seasonality = NA,
  Q = NA,
  Q2 = NA,
  TotalQ = NA,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Child-Serien befüllen über echten Namen
for (i in seq_len(nrow(diag))) {
  
  sn <- diag[[name_col]][i]
  
  if (sn %in% qr_table$series) {
    qr_table$seasonality[qr_table$series == sn] <- diag$seasonality[i]
    qr_table$Q[qr_table$series == sn]          <- diag$Q[i]
    qr_table$Q2[qr_table$series == sn]         <- diag$Q2[i]
    qr_table$TotalQ[qr_table$series == sn]     <- diag$TotalQ[i]
  }
}

tags$style(HTML("
table.dataTable tbody tr {
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}
table.dataTable tbody tr:hover {
  background-color: #e3f2fd !important;
  transform: scale(1.01);
}
table.dataTable tbody tr.selected {
  background-color: #1976D2 !important;
  color: white;
  font-weight: bold;
}
"))
# oder alternativ blaues Highlight enfernen, dafür
# tags$style(HTML("
# table.dataTable tbody tr.selected {
#   background-color: transparent !important;
# }
# "))

dashboard_cache <- reactiveValues()
```

### Overview: `r hts_name`

```{r}
h4("Please select one or more series (click on a row)")

qr_table_view <- qr_table

# qr_table_view$selected <- sprintf(
#   '<input type="checkbox" class="row-select" data-id="%s">',
#   qr_table_view$series
# )
qr_table_view$selected <- sprintf(
  '<input type="checkbox" class="row-select" data-id="%s" style="transform: scale(1.2); cursor:pointer;">',
  qr_table_view$series
)

#qr_table_view <- qr_table_view[c("selected", "series", "quality")]
qr_table_view <- qr_table_view[c("selected", "series", "seasonality","Q", "Q2", "TotalQ")]

output$table <- renderDT({
  datatable(
    qr_table_view,
    rownames = FALSE,
    escape = FALSE,
    selection = "none",
    options = list(
      pageLength = 10,
      dom = "tip"
    ),
callback = JS("

  // 👉 Klick auf ganze Zeile toggelt Checkbox
  table.on('click', 'tbody tr', function(e) {
    if ($(e.target).is('input')) return;
    
    var checkbox = $(this).find('input.row-select');
    checkbox.prop('checked', !checkbox.prop('checked')).trigger('change');
  });

  // 👉 Checkbox Event → Shiny + Blau markieren
  table.on('change', '.row-select', function() {
    
    var id = $(this).data('id');
    var checked = $(this).is(':checked');
    var row = $(this).closest('tr');
    
    if (checked) {
      row.addClass('selected');
    } else {
      row.removeClass('selected');
    }
    
    Shiny.setInputValue('row_checkbox', {
      id: id,
      checked: checked,
      nonce: Math.random()
    });
  });

  // ✅ NEU: Checkbox zurücksetzen von Shiny
  Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler('uncheckRow', function(id) {
    
    $('input.row-select[data-id=\"' + id + '\"]')
      .prop('checked', false)
      .closest('tr')
      .removeClass('selected');
  });

"),
    class = "stripe hover compact"
  )
})

div(
  style = "height: calc(100vh - 200px); overflow-y: auto;",
  DTOutput("table")
)
```

### Details

```{r}
div(
  style = "height: 100%; overflow-y:auto;",
  tabsetPanel(
    id = "details_tabs",
    tabPanel("Start", "Please select a series")
  )
)
```

```{r}
# hält offene Tabs
open_tabs <- reactiveValues(tabs = character())

# close handler
# observeEvent(
#   input$close_tab,
#   {
#     tab_id <- input$close_tab
#     
#     req(tab_id %in% open_tabs$tabs)
#     
#     removeTab("details_tabs", target = tab_id)
#     open_tabs$tabs <- setdiff(open_tabs$tabs, tab_id)
#   },
#   ignoreInit = TRUE
# )
observeEvent(
  input$close_tab,
  {
    tab_id <- input$close_tab
    
    req(tab_id %in% open_tabs$tabs)
    
    removeTab("details_tabs", target = tab_id)
    open_tabs$tabs <- setdiff(open_tabs$tabs, tab_id)
    
    # Seriennamen wieder extrahieren
    series_name <- sub("^tab_", "", tab_id)
    
    # Checkbox + Highlight im Table zurücksetzen
    session$sendCustomMessage("uncheckRow", series_name)
  },
  ignoreInit = TRUE
)

last_selected <- reactiveVal(NULL)

observeEvent(input$row_checkbox, {
  
  series_name <- input$row_checkbox$id
  checked <- input$row_checkbox$checked
  
  tab_id <- paste0("tab_", series_name)
  
  if (checked) {
    
    # Tab existiert → nur aktivieren
    if (tab_id %in% open_tabs$tabs) {
      updateTabsetPanel(session, "details_tabs", selected = tab_id)
      return()
    }
    
    # neuen Tab erstellen
    insertTab(
      inputId = "details_tabs",
      target = "Start",
      position = "after",
      select = TRUE,
      
      tabPanel(
        title = tagList(
          series_name,
          tags$span(
            onclick = sprintf(
              "Shiny.setInputValue('close_tab', '%s', {priority: 'event'})",
              tab_id
            ),
            style = "margin-left:8px; color:#bbb; cursor:pointer;",
            "✕"
          )
        ),
        value = tab_id,
        fluidRow(column(12, uiOutput(paste0("dash_", series_name))))
      )
    )
    
    open_tabs$tabs <- c(open_tabs$tabs, tab_id)
    
    local({
      sn <- series_name
      
      output[[paste0("dash_", sn)]] <- renderUI({
        if (!is.null(dashboard_cache[[sn]])) {
          return(dashboard_cache[[sn]])
        }
        
        obj <- if (sn == "aggregate") {
          hts_object
        } else {
          hts_object$components[[sn]]
        }
        
        ui <- persephone_dashboard(obj)
        dashboard_cache[[sn]] <- ui
        ui
      })
    })
    
  } else {
    
    # Checkbox deaktiviert → Tab schließen
    if (tab_id %in% open_tabs$tabs) {
      removeTab("details_tabs", target = tab_id)
      open_tabs$tabs <- setdiff(open_tabs$tabs, tab_id)
    }
  }
})

```
